canonical_project: China Mobile (Shanxi Taiyuan) Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Reported as the province's largest intelligent-computing center (Shanxi Transformation Comprehensive Reform Demonstration Zone), 10,000 racks, up to 2,000 PFLOPS compute (~2 million PCs), serving AI large-model training, industrial simulation and big-data analytics; part of Shanxi's 16 computing-power projects (over RMB13.8bn total).
